user.title: Add Raspberry Pi 5 Power Monitor
user.description: Reads per-rail voltage and current from the Pi 5's DA9091 PMIC via vcgencmd pmic_read_adc, and surfaces them as HA sensors. Requires HAOS on a Raspberry Pi 5.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one Raspberry Pi 5 Power Monitor entry is supported per HA instance.
abort.already_configured: Only one Raspberry Pi 5 Power Monitor entry is supported per HA instance.

data_description.scan_interval: How often to run vcgencmd and refresh every sensor. 30s is a reasonable default.
